content: प्रवाहः .²1 Flowing or streaming forth. .²2 A stream, course, current; प्रवाहस्ते वारां श्रियमयमपारां दिशतु नः <ls>G. L. 2</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 46</ls>, <ls n="R.">13. 10</ls>, <ls n="R. 13.">48</ls>; <ls>Ku. 1. 54</ls>; <ls>Me. 48</ls>. .²3 Flow, running water. .²4 Continuous flow, unbroken succession, continuity. .²5 Course of events (rolling onward like a stream). .²6 Activity, active occupation. .²7 A pond, lake. .²8 Course or direction towards. .²9 An excellent horse. (प्रवाहेमूत्रितम् means (<ab>lit.</ab>) making water in a stream; (<ab>fig.</ab>) doing a useless action).
